links.outcome: Change in correlation when glucose-rise model is applied to the other dataset
links.effect: Transfer between datasets lost correlation: Δr = -0.11 [-0.17, -0.05] towards ShanghaiT2DM and -0.12 [-0.19, -0.04] towards CGMacros.
links.quote: Applied from one dataset to the other, the model lost correlation (Δr = -0.11 [-0.17, -0.05] towards ShanghaiT2DM and -0.12 [-0.19, -0.04] towards CGMacros).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a small open LLM with QLoRA on public data for offline carbohydrate estimation from meal text
Personalised gradient boosting using pre-meal glucose and the person's usual response to predict postprandial glucose rise

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a pipeline combining a fine-tuned LLM for carbohydrate estimation from meal text and gradient-boosting models for postprandial glucose prediction on retrospective patient cohorts, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
